sentences.en: I'll agree to the terms if you lower the price.
sentences.zh: 如果你降价的话，我同意接受这些条款。

sentences.en: Demand for imported cars is increasing due to lower prices.
sentences.zh: 由于价格降低，进口汽车的需求正在增加。

sentences.en: It is thought that the lower speed reduces heat generation.
sentences.zh: 据说减速可以减少热量产生。

senses.zh: 较低的，低的，下级的，下层的
